turns.prompt: Add a truncate(str, n) function to src/str.js that cuts the string to n characters and appends an ellipsis character when it cuts. Add tests and run them.
texts: I'll look at the existing file and test setup first.

ISSUE.md in this repo describes a different task (`slugify`); I'm going with what you asked for (`truncate`).

One spec ambiguity worth flagging: "cuts to n characters and appends an ellipsis" literally means the result is n+1 characters long. The other common convention is that n is the total budget including the ellipsis. I'm implementing the literal reading — say the word and I'll flip it.
